content: Ndiirà ntɔn mudwà Yɛsu
Byàsäl ilä ibyeel Pak anà un'kyɔm a mampà ikɔ̈ɔ̈n ful mukwo, amfum a angaŋ anà alɔɔŋ a in'kɔɔn bàleŋà impeenà mukɔr Yɛsu, waa bun'dwa.
Ntɔn ba bàtɛɛnà naa: « Kà uboo a un'kyɔm anki, manà lingyoomà layàbilà uboo a un'sɛŋ. »
Un'kaar mwɛy kan'tsuul Yɛsu may a usɔŋ

Yɛsu kàkäl u Bɛtani u ndwà a Simɔn ŋabay, mpal kàkäl nde u mɛsà mudyà, un'kaar mwɛy kàyi anà làbuuŋ aŋàyɔl a may a usɔŋ a ndandaa màntal mbɔɔn. Nde kàduub la, waa kun'tsüül udu a un'tswe.
Baar bumwɛy bàkäl paa bàmɛn ube, waa bàtɛɛnà ba a ba naa: « Ntɔn nkye mubi may a usɔŋ amà abà?
Yàlàbwaŋ naa bàyälà ma màŋàsɔ̈ɔ̈nà nkam tär yà itɛr a ngim, waa bàlàpà aŋàlàmbwà! » Ba bàpɛlà un'kaar awà.
Wɛɛ Yɛsu kàtɛn naa: « Lun'si a duu. Ntɔn nkye lun'paa bɛ mpay? Nde kan'kyer undiir aŋàbwaŋ akà mɛ.
Ntɔn aŋàlàmbwà bɛ làbà anà ba taaŋ lanswà, bɛ lan'kwo mukakyer ubwaŋ mpal làkwen bɛ, wɛɛ mɛ, mɛ anà bɛ watɛy taaŋ lanswà.
Undiir kàkwen nde mukyer, nde kan'kyer wa: kusà nde kan'tsuul ndür amɛ may a usɔŋ ntɔn ndyee aya.
Ndandaa mɛ alàkyään, ntsü yanswà bàsàpay Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ, u mɛɛn manswà, bàsataa ndaa kan'kyer un'kaar wà ntɔn muyɔbà mɔ̈ɔ̈ ande. »
Yudas akwen muyälà Yɛsu
Yudas Iskaryɔt, umwɛy uboo a alɔŋki Kwem Aŋiyweel, kàkyen akà amfum a angaŋ ntɔn mukàyàlà Yɛsu.
Ba bàkäl kà un'sak ntɔn làsaŋ alan. Ba bàdirà mukun'pà ngim. Apan nde kàleŋà ipöl aŋàbwaŋ mukun'yälà.
Ngyööŋà adyà Pak
Ilä atàtwɛb kyà mampà ikɔ̈ɔ̈n ful, ilä bàfàdwa in'tö a in'kɔk ntɔn isaa a Pak, alɔŋki a Yɛsu ban'tɛn a nde naa: « Ikal nà ngye akwen bi ikàyilà ntɔn ngye akàdyà Pak? »
Apan Yɛsu kàtöm alɔŋki ande bɔ̈ɔ̈l, waa kàtɛn a ba naa: « Làkyen u bul a kölàköl, bɛ làkàman baal mwɛy we anà làbuuŋ a an'dà ayàmɛɛn anà bɛ, lun'läb.
Ikal kyanswà ukàbilà nde, làtɛn akà ŋàndwà naa: "Un'lɔɔŋ kan'tɛn naa: Làken suk in'dyà mɛ Pak anà alɔŋki amɛ?"
Nde akàlaswaŋ suk a du làkölàköl làŋakwo anà indiir byanswà. Ngiil ntɔn bi, bɛ làkàkyer kwo. »
Alɔŋki bàkyen ba, bàtɔ̈l ba u bul a kölàköl, ba bàmɛn asànaa kàtɛn nde a ba, waa bàyöŋà Pak.
Mpal làbü sisye, Yɛsu kàyi anà Bàkwem Aŋiyweel.
Umpal bàkäl ba u mɛsà bàmudyà, nde kàtɛn naa: « Ndandaa mɛ alàkyään, umwɛy uboo a bɛ awàmudyà anà mɛ, akyer ayan'yälà. »
Alɔŋki bàmɛn ngyɛb mbɔɔn, waa bàsɛmà mukun'fuul umwɛy umwɛy: « Nkye an'kwo ikäl mɛ? »
Nde kàtɛn a ba naa: « Umwɛy uboo a Bàkwem Aŋiyweel, kan'dümà kɔɔ ande mbwo mwɛy anà mɛ uboo làlɔŋà.
Ntɔn Mwan a mbuur akyer akyà asànaa bàsön ya ntɔn nde, wɛɛ ngyɛb akà mbuur ban'yälà Mwan a mbuur u mbwo a nde! Yàlàkal ubwaŋ mbɔɔn akà nde naa bàkɔɔn un'bɔr! »
Udyà a in'kyɛɛl
Utaaŋ adyà, Yɛsu kàwɛl mampà, ungö musaak ma, nde kàtsül ma, waa kapɛ, waa kàtɛn naa: « Làwɛl, ayi yà ndür amɛ. »
Waa kàwɛl kɔɔb, ungö mufuur an'tɔɔn, nde kapɛ la, waa ba banswà bànü unsà la.
Yɛsu kàtɛn a ba naa: « Amà an'kil amɛ, an'kil a nkwà màtyaŋà ntɔn bàmbɔɔn.
Ndandaa mɛ alàkyään: mɛ in'fàsànwà anki akà ikikye vin tii ilä in'sànwà mɛ vin akün kà imwol a Nzam. »
Ungö mutɔɔl an'diim, ba bàtoo ntɔn mukyà mɔŋ a in'te a Ɔlive.
Yɛsu kan'kyään ntöön a Petɔlà
Yɛsu kàtɛn a ba naa: « Bɛ, bɛ banswà làkyer asan'kɔɔb, ntɔn bàsön naa: "Mɛ in'sàdwa un'kyɛɛŋ, waa in'kɔk isàtà upay."
Wɛɛ mɛ, ungö a ngwiiyà, mɛ in'sàfweel kusà a bɛ u Ngalilɛ. »
Petɔlà kàtɛn a nde naa: « Itàkal naa baar banswà bàmakɔɔb, wɛɛ mɛ, mɛ in'sakɔɔb anki. »
Yɛsu waa utɛn a nde naa: « Ndandaa mɛ akyään: ŋàbawà, mpib nsil ayi, kusà nkɔɔ mubel mbalà yweel, ngye, ngye ayan'tɔn mbalà tär. »
Wɛɛ nde, nde kàfàfuur a ngwal: « Mɛ, itàkal naa mɛ in'kyer akwà anà ngye, aay, mɛ ngye in'satɔn tɛy. » Ba banswà bàkäl mun mwɛy wa.
Yɛsu u Ngɛtɛsɛmani
Apan ba bàyàkɔlà kà ikal mwɛy bàfàbel naa Ngɛtɛsɛmani, Yɛsu waa kàtɛn a alɔŋki ande naa: « Sàlàbwaay pà, umpal in'kàyamà mɛ. »
Ungö nde kàsyen Petɔlà, Yakɔb anà Ywan. Apan nde kàsɛmà muwem matɛɛr anà ngyɛb mbɔɔn.
Nde kàtɛn a ba naa: « Mɔ̈ɔ̈ amɛ wàŋàyɔl a ngyɛb yan'kwo mudwa. Sàlasäl pà, làkyɛŋ. »
Nde kàkyen u kikwɛl, waa kàbü an'köm, kàyamà naa kya mbwo isàkal, taaŋ alà làlyaaŋ ukwɛl apà nde.
Nde kàtɛɛnà naa: « Taa, indiir byanswà akà ngye ikyer afàkwo, lwom kɔɔb a mpay aŋàkir là apà mɛ. Itàkal abwɛy, kà ndaa in'kwen mɛ anki, wɛɛ ayan'kwen ngye. »
Ungö apan nde kan'yà, kan'man ba bàŋàbɔ̈ɔ̈n, waa kan'tɛn a Petɔlà: « Simɔn, ngye an'bɔ̈ɔ̈n? Nkye ngye asàkal anki anà ngwal mukyɛŋ itàkal akà taaŋ làmwɛy?
Làkyɛŋ, làyamà, ntɔn bɛ làkɔ̈ɔ̈n abwà u ndɛb. Dweelà làŋàyɔl a ngwal, wɛɛ ndür ye anà gyɔ̈ɔ̈là. »
Nde kàfàkyà u kikwɛl, waa kàyamà wàmufuur ndaa nsil ya.
Apan, nde kàyi mbalà asin, waa kàfaman bàmubɔ̈ɔ̈n, ntɔn mii aba myàkäl myàŋàbwà buur. Ba waa mpa bàyöb naa bun'fuur aben.
U mbalà yàtär kan'yà nde, nde kan'tɛn a ba naa: « Làläb mubɔ̈ɔ̈n, làyöör. Yan'wà! Taaŋ lan'kwo: le, Mwan a mbuur bàmuyälà kà an'kɔɔ a baar abe.
Làmbarà, tsweenà! Làler, mbuur kàman'yälà wà tsütsü. »
Nköör a Yɛsu
Umpal kàkäl nde muyäämà, Yudasi, umwɛy uboo a Bàkwem Aŋiyweel, kàyàkɔlà anà iköŋ a baar mbɔɔn bàtöm andweer a angaŋ anà andweer a un'sɛŋ. Ba bàkäl anà an'kɔm anà nköl.
Mbuur kun'yälà, kapɛ idiim ki: « Mbuur wanswà in'kàböbà mɛ, mbuur wa nde awun. Lun'kör, lun'syen unsà ikyɛɛŋ. »
Pa kàyàkɔlà nde, nde kàsin apà Yɛsu, waa kàtɛn a nde naa: « Un'lɔɔŋ! » Waa kun'böbà.
Apan bumwɛy bun'tɛ mpi, waa bun'kör.
Umwɛy uboo a baar bàkäl paa, kàtwey kɔm, waa kàkäm un'syääl a Mfum a angaŋ, waa kun'tsül tsü.
Yɛsu kàtɛn a ba naa: « Nkye mɛ in'wà un'dwää baar waa bɛ làyi anà an'kɔm anà nköl ntɔn mukan'kɔr?
Mɛ kàkäl anà bɛ u ndwà a Nzam ilä byanswà mulɔŋ, bɛ làsan'kɔr anki. Wɛɛ ayi yan'yà ntɔn Ndaa Aŋàsɔn ikwe. »
Apan ba banswà bàsun'wɛy, waa bàtiin.
Mwan baal mwɛy wàŋàbwaar làpye làmwɛy mpɛl waa kàyun'labà. Waa bun'kör,
wɛɛ nde kàsàpiy làpye alan, waa kàtiin wànsàpɔl.
Yɛsu u Làbay a nsaŋ a kölàköl
Ba bàsyen Yɛsu akà mfum a angaŋ, ikal bàköŋ amfum a angaŋ bànswà, andweer anà alɔɔŋ a in'kɔɔn.
Petɔlà kàyilabà Yɛsu ukwel tii uboo a làpaŋ, u làbay a ndwà a mfum a angaŋ. Nde kàbwaay anà aŋità muywar mbaa.
Kyekà andweer a angaŋ anà Làbay a nsaŋ a kölàköl bàkäl muleŋ imbäl a loor ntɔn Yɛsu ntɔn bun'dwä, wɛɛ ba kya bàmɛnà anki.
Ntɔn bàmbɔɔn bàtɛɛ imbäl a loor ntɔn nde, wɛɛ bya byàkyeena anki balàbal.
Baar amwɛy waa bàyàmbarà, waa bàyataa loor ntɔn nde naa:
« Bi kàwem nde wàmutɛn naa: "Mɛ in'yàbwaab ndwà a Nzam bàtöŋ yi kàn'kɔɔ a baar, wɛɛ ungö a ilä itär mɛ in'yàtɔŋ yàsin mpa bàkyer kan'kɔɔ a baar." »
Wɛɛ, itàkal abà, imbäl aba kyàkwe anki balàbal.
Apan Mfum a angaŋ kàmbarà nde uboo a nköŋ, nde kàfuul Yɛsu naa: « Nkye ngye afuur anki akà undiir mwɛy unsà imbäl bàtaa baar bà ntɔn ngye? »
Wɛɛ Yɛsu kàkäl akul, waa mpa kàfuur akà ikikye. Mfum a angaŋ kun'fuul mbalà asin: « Nkye ngye awà Klistɔ, Mwan a Nzam aŋàsaak? »
Yɛsu waa kàfuur naa: « Mɛ in'wà nde, bɛ làsàman Mwan a mbuur waŋàbwaay u kɔɔ ibaal a Ŋangwal, wàmuyà uboo in'böŋ a du. »
Apan, Mfum a angaŋ kàkaam ipfɛy ande, waa kàtɛn naa: « Bi ambäl nkye ifàkyer abà!
Bɛ lan'wem mbɛɛy. Bɛ lan'tɛn aben? » Ba banswà bun'tsüül mbar a ukwà.
Bamwɛy uboo a ba bun'tsüülà an'te, bun'fwee ntabwey, bun'kämà iki, waa bàtɛɛnà a nde naa: « Tà ngɔɔm! » Aseey waa bun'yab a mbar.
Petɔlà kan'tɔn Yɛsu
Petɔlà kàkäl u ngyɛl uboo a làpaŋ umpal kàyi un'syääl mwɛy wun'kaar wà mfum a angaŋ,
nde kàmɛn Petɔlà wàmuywar mbaa, nde kun'syebà, waa kàtɛn a nde naa: « Ngye sye, ngye kàkäl anà Yɛsu un'nsi Nasàlɛr. »
Wɛɛ nde kàkyer atɔn, waa kàtɛn naa: « Mɛ in'yöb anki. Mɛ in'yöb anki naa ngye nkye akwen mutɛn. » Ungö, waa kàtoo u nsà mukyà ikal bàfabilà. [ Apan nkɔɔ waa kàbel. ]
Un'syääl wun'kaar kun'mɛn nde, waa kàfàtɛn a baar bàkäl paa naa: « Mbuur wà, wà umwɛy uboo a ba! »
Wɛɛ nde waa kàfàtɔn. Ungö apan, baar bàkäl paa bàfàtɛn a Petɔlà naa: « Ndandaa, ngye awà umwɛy uboo a ba, ntɔn ngye, ngye awà un'nsi Ngalilɛ. »
Wɛɛ nde kàsɛmà mudyà kyän anà musà in'küül: « Mɛ un'yöb anki mbuur lan'saamà bɛ. »

Utaaŋ nsil alan, nkɔɔ mwɛy waa kàbel u mbalà yàyweel, apan Petɔlà kàyɔbà ndaa kun'kyään Yɛsu: « Kusà nkɔɔ mutàbel mbalà yweel, ngye ayan'tɔn mbalà tär. » Apan, nde kàtoo u ntiin, waa kàlel.
